top_signals.title: Iran Reports Fresh Tanker Explosions as Hormuz Attacks Intensify
top_signals.summary: Two oil tankers exploded early on Wednesday after hitting naval mines while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz on routes unauthorized by Iran, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy said. These Iranian reports about tankers that Tehran says are ‘violating’ the Iranian terms of navigation through the chokepoint have become a nearly daily occurrence in the past few weeks. Two tankers hit naval mines off the southern and eastern coasts of the Strait of Hormuz early on Wednesday, resulting in fires erupting in their engine…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Czech jet engine maker eyes growing role as US supplier in drones, missiles
top_signals.summary: Czech jet engine producer PBS Aerospace aims to expand its manufacturing capacity in the United States, targeting at least a twofold increase in its production capacity there.
